value.rationale: Source numerically identifies matching qualitative phase transitions for two mechanistically distinct triad payoff rules. This theorem shows the mechanisms become statistically indistinguishable for any finite hypergraph over a provable trajectory horizon, including a hypothesis-testing bound, proves stationary equivalence with mutation, and determines the optimal exponential base and sharp repeated-experiment sample-complexity exponent via an analytic witness. The fact is useful to interpret numerical simulation and how high curvature approximates complementary production, without claiming a new generic Markov lemma or thermodynamic theorem.
